_comment: CANONICAL SOURCE OF TRUTH for trust protector powers. Edit ONLY this file. Run backend/scripts/generate_trust_protector_powers.py to regenerate the frontend constant, and backend/scripts/check_trust_protector_drift.py to verify no drift. value is the stored key; label and description are user-facing.

powers.label: Remove or replace a trustee
powers.description: Step in to change who manages the trust if the current trustee is not performing properly.

powers.label: Amend the trust for tax efficiency
powers.description: Update the trust to take advantage of favorable tax law or fix tax issues.

powers.label: Veto a proposed distribution
powers.description: Block a distribution the trustee wants to make if it conflicts with the grantor intent.

powers.label: Add or remove beneficiaries
powers.description: Change who benefits from the trust, within the grantor's intent.

powers.label: Resolve disputes between trustees or beneficiaries
powers.description: Act as a tie-breaker to settle disagreements and keep the trust moving.

powers.label: Change the trust's jurisdiction or situs
powers.description: Move the trust to a different state or location where it is administered.

powers.label: Terminate the trust
powers.description: Wind down and distribute the trust if it no longer serves its purpose.
